summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature without running anything, per your instructions. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch now yields (patch, coordinates) pairs; set_rnd skips double-underscore attributes; docstrings updated), monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter; GridPatchDataset reworked to take patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates; PatchDataset docstring uses float), monai/data/__init__.py (exports PatchIter), docs/source/data.rst (PatchIter autodoc after GridPatchDataset), and tests/test_grid_dataset.py (TestGridPatchDataset with test_shape and test_loading_array). Choices to review: start_pos gets a leading 0 for the channel dimension; test_loading_array checks patch values structurally (unshifted patch plus a constant offset) instead of hard-coded seeded values, since those can't be derived without running; the GridPatchDataset docstring example uses ShiftIntensity so its output is deterministic. Nothing was committed. Unverified: the tests have not been run; next step is pytest on tests/test_grid_dataset.py and tests/test_patch_dataset.py plus existing utils tests.
